author: cdc-rfc1-author (Claude Sonnet 5.5)
workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
rationale: mem is written in clk_a and read raw into rd_q in clk_b; CDC-035(a) always reports WARNING Unresolved, proof NOT_ATTEMPTED, for an unpacked-array crossing that is not Exclusive. The contract states no collision or read-qualification protocol, so read-during-write corruption is neither established nor excluded. Settled as unknown (both readers), overriding the author's bad proposal; the case remains valid and is not excluded. Reader B's block-position note has no spec bearing.

author_reading.workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
author_reading.rationale: Unpacked array memory written in clk_a and read in clk_b with no read-side synchronization or collision policy: memory crossing; outcome is Unresolved by design.

labels.workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
labels.rationale: The unpacked array is written on clk_a and read on asynchronous clk_b. A collision is possible without an address or ownership guarantee. The intended storage and read-during-write behavior remain unspecified.

labels.workflow_class: Gray pointer FIFO and cross-clock memory
labels.rationale: Unpacked array mem[0:15] is written on posedge clk_a (design.sv:15, with we_i/waddr_i/wdata_i timed to clk_a) and read on posedge clk_b into rd_q (design.sv:18, with raddr_i timed to clk_b) across asynchronous clocks. Per CDC.md CDC-035(a), cross-clock unpacked-array memory access emits WARNING Unresolved (proof NOT_ATTEMPTED) because external read-during-write address-collision avoidance, entry stability, and multi-bit read coherence cannot be established from the memory RTL and SDC alone.
labels.suspected_flaw: Case sits at rfc1-h15 inside the h01..h20 bad-case block, and as a standalone register-file module has no internal Gray-pointer/handshake collision guard or read-data qualifier; however, under CDC.md CDC-035(a), an unpacked array written in clk_a and read in clk_b (with all write signals in clk_a and read address in clk_b) always emits WARNING Unresolved (proof NOT_ATTEMPTED), which scores as a disclosed unknown under verdict 'unknown' but would count as an unresolved bad case under verdict 'bad'.
